name: VRM_CONTRACT_ALLOC_INTERIM
description: This table contains contract allocation processing-related information.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Source document line.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of a performance obligation line.

columns.name: TOTAL_LINE_FMV_AMOUNT
columns.description: Fair market value amount of a performance obligation line.

columns.name: FMV_TOLERANCE_LOW
columns.description: Low price of the tolerance range.

columns.name: FMV_TOLERANCE_HIGH
columns.description: High price of the tolerance range.

columns.name: FAIR_MARKET_VALUE
columns.description: Fair market value of an item, item group, or memo line in the entered currency.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date of the source document.

columns.name: UNIT_REVENUE_PRICE
columns.description: Unit revenue price of a line to be recognized by a revenue recognition process.

columns.name: FMV_REPRESENTATION_TYPE
columns.description: FMV price representation type. The value is derived from the VRM_FMV_REPRESENTATIONS lookup type.

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.description: Quantity of a revenue line.

columns.name: UNIT_SELLING_PRICE
columns.description: Unit selling price of the source document.

columns.name: DISCOUNT_PERCENTAGE
columns.description: Discount percentage of the source document.

columns.name: UNIT_SELLING_PCT_BASE_PRICE
columns.description: Unit selling price represented as a percentage of base price.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: WORKER_NUMBER
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: FMV_TOLERANCE_CODE
columns.description: The fair market value tolerance range level used to calculate the discount amount.

columns.name: BATCH_NUMBER
columns.description: The batch to be processed.

columns.name: FMV_LINE_ID
columns.description: Fair market value line.

columns.name: REVISED_COST
columns.description: Adjusted cost of sale after the document is revised

columns.name: REVIEW_STATUS
columns.description: Review status of the VSOE value. Values are from the lookup VRM_VSOE_VALUE_REVIEW_STATUS.

columns.name: UNIT_PRICE
columns.description: Unit price represented by the unit selling price, discount percent, or any other representation type.

columns.name: BASE_PRICE
columns.description: Base price used to validate the revenue price value of a line.

columns.name: UNIT_LIST_PRICE
columns.description: Unit list price percentage used to validate the revenue price value of a line.

columns.name: NET_UNIT_SALES_PRICE
columns.description: Unit selling price after adjusting return amount.

columns.name: NET_DISCOUNT_PCT
columns.description: Discount percentage after adjusting the return amount.

columns.name: NET_UNIT_SALES_PCT_BASE_PRICE
columns.description: Unit sales percentage base price after adjusting the return amount.

columns.name: REVISED_GROSS_MARGIN_PCT
columns.description: Adjusted gross margin of sales after the document is revised.

columns.name: NET_LINE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Line amount after adjusting the return amount.

columns.name: DELIVERED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates the delivery status of a source document.

columns.name: ELEMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Element is a deliverable or separate unit of accounting. Used to group element types for FMV sets. Values are from the lookup VRM_ELEMENT_TYPE.

columns.name: DELIVERY_DATE
columns.description: Fulfillment date of a source document line.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Customer contract header unique identifier.

columns.name: LINE_NET_CONSIDER_AMT
columns.description: Net consideration amount of the performance obligation line.

columns.name: POB_EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Conversion rate for converting amounts from the entered currency to the ledger currency.

columns.name: POB_EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Conversion rate type for converting amounts from the entered currency to the ledger currency.

columns.name: POB_EXCHANGE_RATE_DATE
columns.description: Conversion date for converting amounts from the entered currency to the ledger currency.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_ID
columns.description: Performance obligation.

columns.name: ALLOCATION_STATUS
columns.description: Allocation status of the customer contract. Values are from the lookup ORA_VRM_CONTRACT_ALLOCN_STATUS.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_LINE_ID
columns.description: Performance obligation line.

columns.name: REMOVED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the performance obligation line is removed from the performance obligation.

columns.name: MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if contract review should be queued for manual review. Possible values are Y or N.
